relationships.subject: VEGF-A
relationships.evidence_quote: angiopoietin-2, endoglin, FAP, and VEGF-A were significantly (q < 0.0001) upregulated in all EC groups: EC all, grade 1/2 EEC, and other EC types.

key_findings: Cervicovaginal lavage levels of angiopoietin-2, endoglin, FAP, MIA and VEGF-A were elevated in endometrial cancer.
An 11-protein model plus age and BMI gave AUC 0.918 for EC detection; VEGF-A aligned with all tumor characteristics evaluated.
